conclusion: Thirty-three refutation attempts were run against the subject and all thirty-three were refuted against live bytes. The strongest available attack was the required-now remasurement the dispatch names explicitly: frozen v1 carried 'Does not change required-now 26.', and a raw scan of the subject returns six 'required-now 26' hits. Resolving each to its enclosing key shows all six are historical predecessor or leftover-join.v2 framing, or failsIf guard text, while the doesNot roster carries the required live house form 'Does not change live required-now 28.' The second strongest was the pair of strings 'This v1 for this subject' and 'doesNot roster claims required-now 26 as live', both of which appear verbatim in the subject and both of which resolve to failsIf entries at indices 27 and 25 - the artifact enumerating its own failure modes rather than committing them; a grep-only reading would have scored two false blockers here. The third was completeness of the leftoverDesign remainder: rather than accept the subject's singleton, all seven obligations in live leftover-join.v3 were enumerated and filtered, and OBL-G26-FX-AUTHORING is the only one carrying true, so the singleton is complete rather than truncated, and the three already-closed ids are attributed to leftover-join.v3 (D-201) with leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded left empty, so no closure is claimed by this file existing. Provenance holds on every axis the dispatch flags: naming v6 spans DR-G01 through DR-G22 and contains no G26, so it is not treated as the naming parent; parentReview resolves to the D-152 draft under dual CONSENT 0/0; basedOn.d225 carries only recording and role, is last-heading custody, carries no leftover-join lineage, and disclaims occupying G25; and the live G26 harness cell, the whole row and all six extracted cell quotes are byte-exact against file-08 line 362. Fixture bytes remain unauthored, DR-131 NT-5 is not executed by this file existing, DR-133 NT-5 stays on G23, G17 stays inapplicable, required-now stays 28, and nothing is SATISFIED, QUALIFIED, sealed or authorized. No MUST-FIX and no SHOULD-FIX survived verification.
